name: cafe-experience-next
description: Cafe Experience Tracker — Next.js frontend + Express backend (one-terminal runner)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:5002 npm run dev --prefix frontend -- --port 3001"
